title: upstream notice continuity
summary: When distributing copied upstream or third-party source or compiled artifacts in a fork, verify required licenses, attribution and notices remain attached to the material actually redistributed.
statement: When distributing copied upstream or third-party source or compiled artifacts in a fork, verify required licenses, attribution and notices remain attached to the material actually redistributed.
rationale: Independent, checkable coverage of an identified upstream-fork maintenance concern not fully specified by previously selected obligations. General requirements remain in place and are not duplicated.

conditions: An owner-authorized Rust fork maintenance task has an accepted upstream baseline, and this concern falls within the maintained fork's supported contracts.
exceptions: Unpublished or unsupported upstream behavior is not automatically incorporated; approved scope and documented exceptions still govern.
